description: Start a conversation and send the first message. The agent speaks first and opt-in provenance is required. On a sandbox key agentId and brandId are free strings and delivery is simulated.

disclaimer.description: Frequency, rates, HELP and STOP. Appended to this first message on both legs.

expiresAt.description: An absolute deadline instead. Not both.

expiresIn.description: Seconds this message stays worth delivering. Google holds a message for an offline handset up to 30 days — for anything tied to a moment, set this, or a yesterday-shaped question arrives on Thursday and its answer is logged against Thursday.

flow.description: A scripted multi-step survey, driven by us: {id, name, disclaimer, closing|holdOpen, steps:[{id, text, suggestions, smsFallbackText}]}. This is the recommended shape for anything with more than one question — we ask each step, classify the reply, and stop on STOP, so you do not hold the state machine. Supply this INSTEAD of openingText; the first step becomes the opening message.

idempotencyKey.description: Makes a retry safe. Without one, a retried send delivers and bills twice.

media.description: An image, chart, PDF or short video to send with this message.

altText.description: What the file says, for anyone who cannot see it. Required.

url.description: https only — Google fetches it from their own infrastructure, so it must be publicly reachable.

openingText.description: The first message. Required unless you send `flow`, whose first step is the opening.

optinCapturedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when consent was given

optinEvidenceRef.description: Pointer to the proof — a record id or URL

optinMethod.description: How consent was captured, e.g. web_form, appointment_booking

smsFallbackText.description: Required if you send chips or rich content — what the recipient reads on the SMS leg.

suggestions.description: Chips, max 25 chars each, max 11. A string is a quick reply. An object is an action chip — opens a URL, dials, adds a calendar event, shows a location. Reply chips must not be carrier keywords (STOP, CANCEL, YES...). Action chips are excluded from SMS numbering and carry no optionIndex; there is no number that opens a URL.

turnCeiling.description: Max turns before the conversation closes (default 30)

name: cadence_open_conversation
